title: A monthly budget line with pay every two weeks: each period gets the line's monthly amount x 12 over that year's pays, by the pay's own year, the leftover minor units on the year's earliest pays, in a 26-pay year and a 27-pay year (H9, L units q3 to q5, N3)
story: Paid 20,000 every other Friday on the rhythm of Fri 2 Jan 2026, so 2026 has 26 pays (the last on Fri 18 Dec) and 2027 has 27 (Fri 1 Jan to Fri 31 Dec). Set up Mon 21 Dec 2026, after the 18 Dec pay: the bank holds 200,000; the opening split names nothing, so Food's share is by days left. Food is 50,000 a month. Fri 1 Jan the pay is ticked; Sat 2 Jan 3,000 of food. Each later pay is ticked on its day up to Fri 26 Feb. No weekend move (none is needed: the days are Fridays and the holiday table is empty). Every amount is made up.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 200,000 (bank today) - 18,131 (Food left this period: the period from pay@2026-12-18, the 26th of 2026's 26 pays, gets 23,076 (600,000 / 26 is 23,076 with 24 left over, which go to the first 24 pays), x 11 of its 14 days left, rounded down [I4]) + 20,000 (pay 1 Jan) - 22,223 (Food for the period from 1 Jan, the 1st of 2027's 27 pays: 600,000 / 27 is 22,222 with 6 left over, so the first 6 pays get 22,223) + 20,000 (pay 15 Jan) - 22,223 (Food for the period from 15 Jan, pay 2 of 27) + 20,000 (pay 29 Jan) - 22,223 (Food for the period from 29 Jan, pay 3 of 27) = 175,200
asks.note: The plain form (50,000 x 12 / 26 a period, whatever the year) gives 23,077 every period.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 217,000 (bank today: 200,000 + 20,000 pay 1 Jan - 3,000 food 2 Jan) - 19,223 (Food left this period: the period from pay@2027-01-01 gets 22,223, less 3,000 spent) + 20,000 (pay 15 Jan) - 22,223 (Food, pay 2 of 27) + 20,000 (pay 29 Jan) - 22,223 (Food, pay 3 of 27) + 20,000 (pay 12 Feb) - 22,223 (Food, pay 4 of 27) = 191,108

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 297,000 (bank today: 200,000 + 5 pays of 20,000 - 3,000 food) - 22,223 (Food left this period: the period from pay@2027-02-26, pay 5 of 27) + 20,000 (pay 12 Mar) - 22,223 (Food, pay 6 of 27, the last to get a leftover unit) + 20,000 (pay 26 Mar) - 22,222 (Food, pay 7 of 27) + 20,000 (pay 9 Apr) - 22,222 (Food, pay 8 of 27) = 268,110
